title: Sparkly paper plane
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='planeBody' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#f8f8ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#c8d4e8'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='planeWing' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#e8eef8'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#a8b8d0'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='planeFlap' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#d0dae8'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#90a8c8'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#ffe45c'>
    <path d='M20 18 l1.5 4 4 1.5 -4 1.5 -1.5 4 -1.5 -4 -4 -1.5 4 -1.5z'/>
    <path d='M78 22 l1.2 3.2 3.2 1.2 -3.2 1.2 -1.2 3.2 -1.2 -3.2 -3.2 -1.2 3.2 -1.2z'/>
    <path d='M30 78 l1.2 3.2 3.2 1.2 -3.2 1.2 -1.2 3.2 -1.2 -3.2 -3.2 -1.2 3.2 -1.2z'/>
    <path d='M72 72 l1.5 4 4 1.5 -4 1.5 -1.5 4 -1.5 -4 -4 -1.5 4 -1.5z'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#8ee8ff'>
    <circle cx='52' cy='14' r='2.2'/>
    <circle cx='86' cy='52' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='14' cy='48' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='48' cy='88' r='2.2'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#ffb0e0'>
    <circle cx='66' cy='24' r='1.6'/>
    <circle cx='24' cy='60' r='1.6'/>
    <circle cx='62' cy='82' r='1.6'/>
  </g>

  <!-- paper plane -->
  <!-- bottom wing -->
  <polygon points='46,52 24,72 64,64' fill='url(#planeWing)' stroke='#90a8c8' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <polygon points='46,52 76,30 60,60' fill='url(#planeBody)' stroke='#c0cce0' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- top wing -->
  <polygon points='46,52 76,30 54,38' fill='url(#planeFlap)' stroke='#a0b4cc' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- fold line highlight -->
  <line x1='46' y1='52' x2='60' y2='60' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='46' y1='52' x2='54' y2='38' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
